name: paper-poster-imagegen
title_zh: 把论文变成高保真海报参考图，先看图再动手做
tagline_zh: 做ACL/NeurIPS海报前，先让AI生成、批评、迭代图像提示词，得到版式参考图。不用盲改HTML，先定视觉方向。
tagline_en: Before building that A0 poster, generate and critique image prompts to lock the visual direction—no more blind.
desc_en: Generate, critique, and iterate image-generation prompts for high-fidelity academic paper poster reference mockups before implementing HTML/PDF/PPTX. Use when Codex is asked to create a poster concept image, imagegen prompt, visual reference draft, layout mockup, or "生图" design for ACL/EMNLP/NeurIPS-style A0 posters from a paper, figures, metrics, logos, QR codes, or an existing poster screenshot.
why_zh: 它把图像生成当成可批评、可迭代的中间产物，而非最终结果。先看图定版式，再落代码，减少返工。
why_en: Treats imagegen as a criticizable, iterable intermediate—not the final output. Settle the layout visually before touching code.
limit_zh: 只产出海报参考图，不生成HTML/PDF/PPTX。需要论文图表、指标、logo等素材已备好；若输入只有标题。
limit_en: Outputs only reference mockups, not final files. Needs paper figures, metrics, logos ready; with just a title, layouts turn generic.
